directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Diesel 30 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Theoretical Output 15 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure 20 MPa. Output is a volume rate. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lever.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油30型混凝土泵的理论输送量写成15 m³/h，把最大出口压力写成20 MPa。柴油30型混凝土泵这一页把理论输送量写成15 m³/h，把最大出口压力单独写成20 MPa。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lever。

body.en: Downloaded from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lever. The image subject is Palanca ejemplo. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Diesel 30 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Theoretical Output 15 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure 20 MPa. A number in m³/h is a volume rate, and a number in MPa is pressure. Stroke length, cycle rate and price are absent from both the caption and this catalogue row. Main-unit weight is 2000 kg.
body.zh: 此图下载自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lever。画面内容是Palanca ejemplo。河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油30型混凝土泵的理论输送量写成15 m³/h，把最大出口压力写成20 MPa。行程、冲次和价格在说明文字和这一行目录里都没有。

body.en: Output is a volume rate. Hopper capacity is 0.3 m³. The Xingtai row does not list a service interval, a seal torque, an export destination or a job case. Those shown extras are still not a stroke length.
body.zh: 柴油30型混凝土泵这一页把理论输送量写成15 m³/h，把最大出口压力单独写成20 MPa。邢台这一行没有标出保养小时间隔、密封扭矩、出口国家或工程案例。

body.en: Pressure is a separate entry on the same sheet. Maximum aggregate size is 3 cm and below. Hopper capacity is 0.3 m³.
body.zh: 最大骨料粒径 3 cm and below。最大骨料粒径 3 cm and below。

body.en: On the Diesel 30 Concrete Pump sheet, Theoretical Output is 15 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure is 20 MPa. Main-unit weight is 2000 kg. Maximum aggregate size is 3 cm and below.
body.zh: 河北品锦机械不把这句说明当成柴油30型混凝土泵的铭牌。

question.en: What output does the Diesel 30 Concrete Pump sheet list?
question.zh: 柴油30型混凝土泵这一页的输送量标出多少？

answer.en: Theoretical Output is 15 m³/h. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lever.
answer.zh: 理论输送量是15 m³/h。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lever画面里印出的数字。

question.en: What pressure entry is on the same sheet?
question.zh: 同一页的压力格是多少？

answer.en: Max. Outlet Pressure is 20 MPa. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lever.
answer.zh: 最大出口压力是20 MPa。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lever画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: No. The sheet leaves stroke length, cycle rate and price unprinted. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lever.
answer.zh: 没有。这一页没有标出行程、冲次和价格。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lever画面里印出的数字。
